Things l've learned so far on YouTube:
1. Post fast, don't overthink
2. First 50 videos = practice
3. Title + thumbnail do matter
4. Hook viewers in 1-3 seconds
5. Be consistent, not perfect
6. Talk to your audience
7. Study what works, repeat it
8. Have fun or you'll quit
9. And remember - you're doing great. Keep creating, keep growing, keep shining..
I hope I can get 1,000 subscribers soon
